compute: dislab CPU only, local display/transport only
forecast: Existing H13 stationwise GCN+FlowMatching frozen128samples; no H14 gate bypass or new model superiority claim

optimization.method: Exhaust all integer station-net choices and feasible single-visit route permutations within<=5selectedcandidates; verify conservation/load/terminal supply/time; complete search or fail explicitly after15seconds, never call partial result optimal.
optimization.risk: mean total target shortfall + CVaR90 total shortfall of unchanged supplied scenarios
optimization.scope: Best computed objective within selected candidate set, one vehicle, integer caps and fixed estimated road matrix; not citywide/field optimum.

ui.content: Operational map, candidate/quantity/sequence/legkm/ETA/load and resource controls. No hypothesis/research/PR/experiment pages in product. Model attribution only Flow Matching + GCN. Record date and planning assumptions remain visible.
ui.interaction: Change resource/candidate/depot/objective -> debounced remote calculation; ignore stale responses, preserve invalid/unavailable states; route animation labeledsimulation; CSV export plan.

acceptance: directed leg distance sum matches total and minutes+service match route
pickup/delivery conservation and every load bound
source pickup safety respects fixed current and scenario limits
changed capacity/deadline/exclusion accepted and reflected, no fake fixed return
future labels absent from prepared RPC state and UI response
model weights unchanged and dispatch false
no original hypothesis/experiment content in operational HTML
road failure explicit and no default fabricated distance
decision: supported only if all engineering acceptance checks pass; no accuracy/effectiveness inference
